notes: Added missing schema/contract and core lifecycle logic stories to complete feature coverage.

stories.title: Token Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the token schema for bearer tokens including token_id, hashed_token, agent_id, scope, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_parent_id, revocation_status, and audit metadata. Ensure schema is enforced in MongoDB and aligns with existing auth validation flows.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend validation logic to enforce token expiration during every authenticated request. Expired tokens must be rejected with consistent error handling and logged for audit without exposing token values.

stories.title: Token Rotation Core Logic
stories.description: Implement secure token rotation mechanism that issues a new token, links it to the prior token via rotation_parent_id, and invalidates the previous token. Ensure atomicity to prevent race conditions and token reuse.
